data.name: Shimei
data.gender_notes: Shimei is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Name of a man from Mount Ephraim
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Shimei means 'from Saul's family'. He is a man from Mount Ephraim who cursed David during his flight from Absalom. (2 Samuel 16:5-14). The name Shimei carries the meaning “Name of a man from Mount Ephraim” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Shimei usually hope their child will grow to embody name of a man from mount ephraim and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes resilience and loyalty to one's roots.
data.etymology: Shimei belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Name of a man from Mount Ephraim.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shimei total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם שמעי הוא שמו של אחד מבניו של גד, שמעי בן גדי היה אחד מהשרים ששירתו את המלך דוד. על שם שמעי נאמר כי הוא בא מהמילה שמע, שפירושה להקשיב ולשמוע. השם שמעי נמצא בספר שמואל ב, פרק טז, פסוקים ט-י

in_greek.name: Σιμεΐ
in_greek.meaning: Όνομα που σημαίνει ακούω και υπακούω
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σιμεΐ προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη שמע, που σημαίνει να ακούω ή να υπακούω. Στο βιβλίο του Β' Σαμουήλ, ο Σιμεΐ ήταν ένας από τους υπηρέτες του βασιλιά Δαυίδ. Το όνομα Σιμεΐ είναι σημαντικός στα πρώιμα χρόνια της χριστιανικής εκκλησίας και αντανακλά την πνευματική σημασία της ακρόασης και της υπακοής στο Θεό

in_latin.name: Shimei
in_latin.meaning: Name meaning to hear and obey
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Shimei originates from the Hebrew word שמע, meaning to hear or to obey. Shimei, son of Gera, was a servant of King David mentioned in the Bible, specifically in 2 Samuel 16:9-10. The name holds significant spiritual meaning in the context of early Christian tradition, emphasizing the importance of listening to and obeying God's will

in_english.name: Shimei
in_english.meaning: A name that signifies hearing or obedience
in_english.long_meaning: The name Shimei is derived from the Hebrew root שמע, which means 'to hear' or 'to obey'. In the biblical context, Shimei was the name of several individuals, including a son of Gera who served King David (2 Samuel 16:9-10). The name carries spiritual significance in Christian tradition, symbolizing the virtues of attentiveness to God's word and obedience to His commandments. Throughout history, the name Shimei has been used across various Christian cultures, reflecting its enduring appeal as a symbol of devotion and faithfulness

data.cultural_impact: The name Shimei appears seven times in the Old Testament and the New Testament, and its root, Shema, which means 'hear', plays an important role in Judaism and Christianity. Shimei's name is an reminder of the historic connection between the Israelite tribes, emphasizing their common origin and tribal identity.
data.spiritual_significance: In the story of Shimei, we see a contrast between the curses he hurled at David and the blessings he later received from God. Despite his disdain and disloyalty, Shimei's lives were spared, and he was ultimately restored to the covenant community (2 Samuel 19:21-31). Shimei's story serves as a reminder that even those who harbor ill will can be redeemed by God, and that His mercy and forgiveness are available to all. Additionally, the name Shimei highlights the importance of hearing and responding to God's call, following the exhortation in Deuteronomy 7:12: "Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength."
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shimei could be interpreted as "hateful" or "rude" in Hebrew, representing the Old Testament figure who cursed and threw stones at King David. Yet, this name also symbolizes the potential for transformation, as Shimei later repents and joins David's army. Thus, Shimei may serve as a reminder of the power of redemption and the capacity for change in even the most adversarial relationships.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Ruth Shimei in Jerusalem, Israel credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Shimei, which means "Name of a man from Mount Ephraim". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
